notes: Hard (bucket 18+) because the highest competency floor (rstan/pystan posterior-sampling workflow, C-ed60d55a) is hard. The agent must (1) port an rstan sampling configuration faithfully to PyStan's num_warmup/num_samples/num_chains semantics (the classic warmup-vs-total misallocation bug would bias posterior means), (2) run a deterministic multi-chain NUTS sampler that compiles live via httpstan within the wall-clock budget and persists posterior means/draws that recover the data-generating parameters, and (3) select a lasso regularization penalty corroborated across cross-validation and a corrected (AICc) information criterion while keeping a distinct ridge variant. Quantitative correctness drives most of the score (posterior means must land inside tolerances on the default AND on hidden datasets; the chosen penalty must reproduce under an independent re-derivation on holdouts), plus hidden-case generalization because the verifier re-runs both the sampler and the penalty selector on unseen datasets and cross-checks the reported penalty against an independent computation.
